entries.name: MoveSafely
entries.description: Path a Battlecruiser safely to a target.

entries.name: TacticalJump
entries.description: Tactical Jump a Battlecruiser to a target.

entries.name: AMove
entries.description: Attack-move a unit toward a target.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: Distance at which we don't need to issue a new move command because it's near the target.

entries.name: AttackTarget
entries.description: Attack a specified enemy unit or structure.

params.name: extra_range
params.description: Accepted for API compatibility; currently ignored by the implementation.

entries.name: AutoUseAOEAbility
entries.description: Automatically cast an available supported AoE.

params.name: bonus_tags
params.description: Enemy unit tags to prioritize when choosing the spell position. Defaults to an empty set.

params.name: recalculate
params.description: If unit is already using ability, should we recalculate this behavior?

params.name: stack_same_spell
params.description: Stack spell in same position? Default is False.

entries.name: CombatManeuver
entries.description: Try combat behaviors in order until one acts.

params.name: micros
params.description: A list of behaviors that should be executed. Defaults to an empty list.

entries.name: DropCargo
entries.description: Unload cargo from a transport.

params.name: target
params.description: Ignored; unloads at the container's current position.

entries.name: GhostSnipe
entries.description: Snipe a nearby valid enemy.

entries.name: KeepUnitSafe
entries.description: Move a unit away from danger using an influence grid.

entries.name: MedivacHeal
entries.description: Use a Medivac to cast Heal on nearby allied biological units.

params.name: unit
params.description: The Medivac that will heal allied biological units.

params.name: keep_safe
params.description: Attempt to stay safe, this may result in not always healing units (Default is True)

entries.name: MoveToSafeTarget
entries.description: Move to a safe point near the target.

params.name: use_pathing
params.description: Whether to use pathing or just move directly towards the target. Defaults to True.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: If the unit is within this distance of the target, do not issue another pathing command. Defaults to 1.0.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Whether to smooth out the path. Defaults to False.

params.name: sense_danger
params.description: Whether to check for dangers. If none are present, the pathing query is skipped. Defaults to True.

params.name: danger_distance
params.description: Accepted for API compatibility; currently not forwarded to the pathing behavior.

params.name: danger_threshold
params.description: Accepted for API compatibility; currently not forwarded to the pathing behavior.

params.name: radius
params.description: How far to look for a safe spot around the target. Defaults to 12.0.

entries.name: NydusPathUnitToTarget
entries.description: Path to a target, using Nydus when suitable.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: Stop pathing when the unit is closer than this distance to the target. Defaults to 0.0.

params.name: large
params.description: Accepted for API compatibility; currently unused by the implementation.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Whether to smooth out the path. Defaults to False.

params.name: exit_nydus_max_influence
params.description: Maximum enemy influence of nydus exit If above this value unit will not path through nydus. Defaults to 10.0.

entries.name: PathUnitToTarget
entries.description: Path a unit toward a target.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: If the unit has gotten this close, consider path behavior complete. Defaults to 0.0.

params.name: smoothing
params.description: Whether to smooth out the path. Defaults to False.

params.name: sense_danger
params.description: Whether to check for dangers. If none are present, the pathing query is skipped. Defaults to True.

params.name: danger_distance
params.description: If `sense_danger` is True, how far to check for dangers. Defaults to 20.0.

params.name: danger_threshold
params.description: Influence at which a danger is respected. Defaults to 5.0.

entries.name: PickUpAndDropCargo
entries.description: Load units, transport them, and optionally unload.

params.name: grid
params.description: Pathing grid for the container unit.

params.name: pickup_targets
params.description: Units we want to load into the container.

params.name: should_drop_units
params.description: Whether to drop units once they are loaded. Defaults to True.

params.name: keep_dropship_safe
params.description: If true, will keep dropship safe if nothing else to do. Defaults to True.

params.name: success_at_distance
params.description: Distance at which pathing to target stops being checked. Defaults to 2.0.

entries.name: PickUpCargo
entries.description: Approach and load the nearest selected unit.

params.name: grid
params.description: Pathing grid for the container unit.

params.name: pickup_targets
params.description: Units we want to load into the container.

entries.name: PlacePredictiveAoE
entries.description: Predict enemy movement and place a delayed AoE.

params.name: unit
params.description: The unit to fire the AoE.

params.name: path
params.description: Path must end at the predicted target position.

entries.name: QueenSpreadCreep
entries.description: Place a Creep Tumor near a creep edge.

params.name: cancel_if_close_enemy
params.description: While the Queen is spreading creep, move her to safety if nearby enemy influence is dangerous.

params.name: pre_move_queen_to_tumor
params.description: Move the Queen toward a planned tumor placement even when she lacks energy to place it.

entries.name: RavenAutoTurret
entries.description: Deploy an Auto-Turret near enemies.

entries.name: ReaperGrenade
entries.description: Throw a grenade at nearby enemies.

params.name: unit
params.description: The Reaper that throws the grenade.

params.name: place_predictive
params.description: Whether to predicatively place the grenade.

params.name: reaper_grenade_range
params.description: The range at which to use the grenade.

entries.name: ShootAndMoveToTarget
entries.description: Move toward a destination while attacking enemies in range.

params.name: dist_to_target
params.description: Distance away from target where pathfinding stops. Default value of 4.0 means that once within 4 tiles of the target we stop pathfinding.

params.name: attack_destructables
params.description: Whether we should shoot destructibles. Default value is `True`.

entries.name: ShootTargetInRange
entries.description: Attack a suitable target in range.

params.name: extra_range
params.description: Look outside the unit's weapon range. This might be useful for hunting down low HP units.

entries.name: SiegeTankDecision
entries.description: Siege or unsiege based on nearby threats.

params.name: stay_sieged_near_target
params.description: This is useful for tanks in defensive position. If on offensive, might not be needed Default is False.

params.name: remain_sieged
params.description: Sometimes we might just want to leave the tank sieged up Default is False.

params.name: force_unsiege
params.description: We might want to not ever siege Default is False.

entries.name: StutterUnitBack
entries.description: Attack when ready; otherwise retreat.

params.name: kite_via_pathing
params.description: Use the influence-grid safety behavior to retreat. False is currently unimplemented and produces no retreat action.

entries.name: StutterUnitForward
entries.description: Attack when ready; otherwise advance.

entries.name: TumorSpreadCreep
entries.description: Spread creep toward a nearby edge.

entries.name: UseAOEAbility
entries.description: Use an area-of-effect ability against suitable targets.

params.name: avoid_own_flying
params.description: Avoid own flying with this spell? Default is False.

params.name: avoid_own_ground
params.description: Avoid own ground with this spell? Default is False.

params.name: bonus_tags
params.description: Enemy unit tags to prioritize when choosing the spell position. Defaults to an empty set.

params.name: recalculate
params.description: If unit is already using ability, should we recalculate this behavior?

params.name: stack_same_spell
params.description: Stack spell in same position? Default is False.

entries.name: UseAbility
entries.description: Use an ability, optionally on a target.

params.name: ability
params.description: The ability we want to use.

params.name: unit
params.description: The unit to use the ability.

entries.name: UseTransfuse
entries.description: Use a Queen to cast Transfusion on a valid allied biological target.

params.name: extra_range
params.description: Look a bit further out of transfuse range? Default is 0.0

entries.name: WorkerKiteBack
entries.description: Attack when ready; otherwise mineral-walk away.

params.name: should_attack
params.description: Whether to attack `target`. If False, will always try to retreat
